data.raw_text:
[3:46PM] #MobolajiBankAnthonyWay #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Idiroko towards Maryland intersection is generally good, though there is a slight delay approaching the intersection due to traffic lights regulating flow into Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way, as well as towards Ojota axis.

Traffic along Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way towards NITEL Junction remains steady, with minor delays from Customs/Unity down to the General Hospital underbridge, while the return journey is smooth.

Movement from Kodesho towards the Ikeja underbridge is slow, attributed to the evening rush, though the return trip is free-flowing. Oba Akran Avenue, Airport Road, and Oba Akinjobi Road all have good vehicular flow.

No major obstructions reported, as personnel remain on ground effectively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[6:46PM] #Jibowu_Yaba_Oyingbo #TrafficUpdate 

Adekunle intersection to 3rd Mainland Bridge, Makoko Junction, Panti, and Alagomeji are experiencing smooth movement. 
However, approaching Sabo is congested due to traffic light alternations. 
Other routes like St. Agnes to Unilag Junction, Jibowu underneath the bridge, Yaba Phase 1 and 2, Murtala Muhammad to Oyingbo, and Oyingbo to Iddo are moving well. 
Kano Street to Adekunle is moving steadily. No impediments are reported, and officers are on ground managing traffic effectively.

#FollowLASTMA
